hypotheses.justification: Neither the remaining statement nor the proof uses htame. Deleting it leaves the existing proof unchanged, including when the quantified set is empty.

Recover hrN locally: Nat.Prime.dvd_mul applied to hr splits r ∣ N * p into r ∣ N or r ∣ p. In the second case, transitivity with hpN also gives r ∣ N. Either case gives hNS r hr ‹r ∣ N› : r ∈ S, contradicting hrS. The existing proof then applies unchanged. This argument requires no additional nonzero assumptions.
